ruleDefinitions.name: Invoke-Obfuscation CLIP+ Launcher - Security
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Obfuscated use of Clip.exe to execute PowerShell Note: Unmapped fields: ServiceFileName

sequences.query: (event_id = 4697 AND (ServiceFileName = RGX(".*cmd.*") AND ServiceFileName = RGX(".*\\&\\&.*") AND ServiceFileName = RGX(".*clipboard\\]\\:\\:.*")))
